据报道，在最近的磁力风暴之后，[this.GetName]出现了不寻常的后遗症。风暴的强大能量场增加了行星熔融核心的磁场波动，导致科技基础设施普遍失灵。

texts.en:
Unusual after effects are being reported on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent Magnetic Storm. The storm's potent energy fields increased magnetic volatility in the planet's molten core, resulting in the widespread failure of technological infrastructure.

However, the situation also presents a unique resource extraction opportunity. Metal-rich lava flows underneath the planet's mantle are now electromagnetically charged and can be harvested with the aid of mining magnets.

# 超磁化行星核心 / Hyper-Magnetized Planetary Core

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:2765-2847; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5432 · DLC: Cosmic Storms · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

磁暴离开拥有殖民地的星系时（on_storm_left_system，00_on_actions.txt:5432），隐藏事件 cstorms.1700 有25%概率（已有强磁场则50%）在一个未受影响的非人造殖民星球上排程，90天后 cstorms.1705。

When a magnetic storm leaves a system with a colony (on_storm_left_system, 00_on_actions.txt:5432) hidden cstorms.1700 has a 25% chance (50% on a planet with a strong magnetic field) of scheduling cstorms.1705 on an unaffected non-artificial colony after 90 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

cstorms.1705“超磁化行星核心”：星球获得 pm_magnetized_planetary_core 修正（每国一次，已有弱磁场的星球不会被选中）。

cstorms.1705 "Hyper-Magnetized Planetary Core": the planet gets the pm_magnetized_planetary_core modifier (once per country; planets with a weak magnetic field are not chosen).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项“令人着迷”。

Single option "Fascinating".

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

Cosmic Storms DLC；每国一次。

Cosmic Storms DLC; once per country.
